biography.value: Magma Lords are the point at which Fire Nephilim become a genuine threat to organized groups rather than individual combatants. Intimidating Presence at Hard task scatters most formations on arrival. Magma Hurl's 10-foot diameter means ranged enemies cannot cluster without taking shared fire damage on every throw. The Heat Aura at this range punishes anyone who tries to engage in melee without significant fire resistance. A summoner deploying one against a disciplined formation should expect the formation to stop being disciplined within the first round.

system.attacksNotes:
Inferno Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage; target gains Burning condition; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage + Burning; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.

Magma Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 80/160 ft, 10-foot diameter on impact.

  • Margin 1:: 15 fire damage (12 + 3 Dex) + Singed.
  • Margin 2: 15 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Ignited.
  • Margin 3: 15 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Heat Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 10 feet take 8 fire damage (Half DR). Powerful Build: The Magma Lord counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Smoldering Wounds: When the Magma Lord deals Ignited or Burning condition to a target, that target cannot remove the condition through normal means for 1 round. Magical healing still removes it. Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 30 feet that can see and hear it make a Will save (opposed by Cha 4 + Intimidate 5). On failure: target gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Magma Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
